## 1. Project Overview & Scope

A minimalist blog website application where users can register, log in, browse and search blogs, sort them, and perform CRUD operations on their own blog posts. The application is intentionally limited to essential functionality to support a complete agentic SDLC workflow.

### 1.1 In Scope
- User registration, login, logout, and session management
- Home page blog feed with search and sorting
- Blog create, read, update, delete (CRUD) with author-only modification

### 1.2 Out of Scope (per source)
- Image uploads
- Email OTP / password reset flows
- Rich WYSIWYG editors

---

## 2. Functional Requirements

### Epic 1: Authentication & Session Management

#### US-101: User Registration
**As a** new visitor, **I want** to create an account by providing a username, email, and password, **so that** I can access blog authoring features.

| ID | Acceptance Criterion |
|---|---|
| US-101-AC1 | A registration page/view provides input fields for Username, Email, and Password. |
| US-101-AC2 | Client-side validation ensures fields are non-empty and passwords meet a minimum length. |
| US-101-AC3 | The system checks for duplicate usernames/emails and displays an error if a conflict exists. |
| US-101-AC4 | Successful registration redirects the user to the Login page. |

#### US-102: User Login
**As a** registered user, **I want** to log in with my credentials, **so that** I can create, edit, or delete my blog posts.

| ID | Acceptance Criterion |
|---|---|
| US-102-AC1 | A login page/view provides input fields for Username/Email and Password. |
| US-102-AC2 | Valid credentials authenticate the user and redirect to the Home Page. |
| US-102-AC3 | Invalid credentials display an appropriate error message. |

#### US-103: Session Persistence & Logout
**As a** logged-in user, **I want** my session to persist across page refreshes but expire after 30 minutes of inactivity or on explicit logout.

| ID | Acceptance Criterion |
|---|---|
| US-103-AC1 | Refreshing the page or opening a new tab retains the authenticated session. |
| US-103-AC2 | A visible **Logout** button terminates the session and redirects to the Login page. |
| US-103-AC3 | The session times out after 30 minutes of inactivity, requiring re-authentication. |

---

### Epic 2: Home Page & Blog Browsing

#### US-201: View Home Page & Blog Feed
**As a** user, **I want** to see a list of all blog posts on the home page showing title, content snippet, author name, and date.

| ID | Acceptance Criterion |
|---|---|
| US-201-AC1 | The Home Page displays a chronological feed of all blogs created across all users. |
| US-201-AC2 | Each blog card shows: **Blog Title**, **Author Name**, **Date Published/Modified**, and a content preview. |
| US-201-AC3 | Clicking a blog opens its full reading view. |

#### US-202: Search Blogs
**As a** user, **I want** to search blogs by keyword, **so that** I can find topics of interest quickly.

| ID | Acceptance Criterion |
|---|---|
| US-202-AC1 | A search input bar is present on the Home Page. |
| US-202-AC2 | Entering text filters the blog list in real time or on submission, matching keywords in titles or content. |
| US-202-AC3 | An empty-state message ("No blogs found") displays when there are no matches. |

#### US-203: Sort Blogs
**As a** user, **I want** to sort the blog list by title or date modified (ascending and descending).

| ID | Acceptance Criterion |
|---|---|
| US-203-AC1 | A sorting control on the Home Page offers: Title (A-Z / Z-A) and Date Modified (Newest first / Oldest first). |
| US-203-AC2 | Selecting an option immediately re-orders the displayed feed. |

---

### Epic 3: Blog CRUD & Security

#### US-301: Create Blog Post
**As a** logged-in user, **I want** to write and publish a new blog post via a creation form.

| ID | Acceptance Criterion |
|---|---|
| US-301-AC1 | A "Create Blog" option is accessible only to authenticated users. |
| US-301-AC2 | The form contains **Title** and **Content** fields. |
| US-301-AC3 | Submitting saves the blog, assigns the logged-in user as author, and redirects appropriately. |

#### US-302: Edit & Update Blog Post
**As a** blog author, **I want** to edit and update my own posts.

| ID | Acceptance Criterion |
|---|---|
| US-302-AC1 | An "Edit" button is visible on a blog post *only* if the logged-in user is the original author. |
| US-302-AC2 | Clicking "Edit" opens the form pre-populated with existing data. |
| US-302-AC3 | Submitting updates the blog and its `date modified` timestamp. |
| US-302-AC4 | Unauthorized attempts to edit another user's blog are blocked (403 Forbidden / redirection). |

#### US-303: Delete Blog Post
**As a** blog author, **I want** to delete my own posts if I no longer want them published.

| ID | Acceptance Criterion |
|---|---|
| US-303-AC1 | A "Delete" button is visible *only* to the original author. |
| US-303-AC2 | A confirmation prompt appears before deletion. |
| US-303-AC3 | Confirming removes the blog from storage and updates the feed. |
| US-303-AC4 | Unauthorized deletion attempts by other users are blocked. |

## 3. Non-Functional Requirements & Constraints

| ID | Category | Requirement |
|---|---|---|
| NFR-01 | UI Design | Clean, minimalist UI suitable for agentic code generation. |
| NFR-02 | Security | Role-based access control: authors may only modify/delete their own posts. |
| NFR-03 | Security | Secure password handling (passwords must not be stored or transmitted in plain text). |
| NFR-04 | Security | Session timeout enforced at 30 minutes of inactivity. |
| NFR-05 | Scope | No image uploads, email OTP password resets, or rich WYSIWYG editors. |

## 5. Ambiguities, Gaps & Assumptions (for reviewer decision)

The source page does not specify the following. Proposed defaults are listed; please confirm or override at review.

| # | Gap | Proposed Default |
|---|---|---|
| Q1 | **Technology stack** is not specified. | Decided in Step 2 (Architecture); to be proposed there. |
| Q2 | **Minimum password length** (US-101-AC2) is unspecified. | 8 characters. |
| Q3 | **Duplicate check semantics** (US-101-AC3): case sensitivity of username/email. | Case-insensitive uniqueness for both. |
| Q4 | **Can anonymous (logged-out) visitors browse the feed?** US-201 says "a user"; US-102-AC2 redirects to Home after login; US-301-AC1 restricts only creation. | Home feed and full blog view require login (unauthenticated users are redirected to Login). *Alternative: public read access.* |
| Q5 | **Inactivity definition** (US-103-AC3): what counts as activity. | Any authenticated request/user interaction resets the 30-minute timer. |
| Q6 | **Session scope across tabs** (US-103-AC1) and logout in one tab. | Session shared across tabs of the same browser; logout in one tab ends the session for all. |
| Q7 | **Feed ordering default** (US-201-AC1 "chronological"). | Newest first by date modified until the user selects a sort. |
| Q8 | **"Date Published/Modified"** display (US-201-AC2). | Show date modified (equals created date if never edited). |
| Q9 | **Content snippet length** (US-201). | First 150 characters, ellipsis if truncated. |
| Q10 | **Search behavior**: real-time vs. on submit; case sensitivity. | Real-time, case-insensitive, substring match on title and content. Search and sort apply together. |
| Q11 | **Post-create redirect** (US-301-AC3 "redirects appropriately"). | Redirect to the new blog's full reading view. |
| Q12 | **Blog field limits/validation** (title/content max length, non-empty). | Title required, max 150 chars; content required, max 10,000 chars; plain text. |
| Q13 | **Unauthorized edit/delete response** (US-302-AC4 "403 / redirection"). | Return 403 on the server side; UI additionally hides Edit/Delete for non-authors. |
| Q14 | **Pagination** of the feed. | Not required (minimalist scope); revisit if needed. |
| Q15 | **Account management** (profile edit, account deletion, password change) and behavior of a deleted user's posts. | Out of scope; not supported. |
| Q16 | **Login identifier** (US-102-AC1 "Username/Email"). | Accept either; match case-insensitively. |
